name: Mopas Marketcilik Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret
summary: MOPAS Marketçilik Gida Sanayi ve Tic AS functions as an e-supermarket, providing a comprehensive array of provisions to its customers. Its extensive product catalog features fresh fruits and vegetables, a variety of red and white meats, essential dairy and breakfast items, cleaning solutions and household detergents, sweet confectionery, diverse beverages, personal care and paper products, supplies for home and pets, baby necessities, organic selections, and a range of prepared food options. The company, established on April 12, 1996, maintains its principal office in Pendik, Turkey.
